threshold_selection: The threshold was set before the SDXL test to the Pixart calibration real-photo maximum (0.930655) rounded upward by 0.01. It is a high-precision indicator, not a general probability threshold.
target_definition: A conservative local high-confidence DDA pixel signal for an unmodified upload. Scores below the threshold are indeterminate and must not be read as evidence of camera origin.

calibration.dataset: Projective Geometry Recent Pixart indoor/outdoor; 40 real and 40 generated images

evaluation.external_generator_heldout: Projective Geometry Recent SDXL indoor/outdoor; 40 real and 40 generated images
